prompt: Create a state machine diagram for our Luca workflow engine. It has a parent workflow machine with states: idle (initial), preflight, routing, discussing, planning, executing, verifying, learning, committing, complete, paused, suspended, and failed. The happy path flows idle → preflight → routing → discussing → planning → executing → verifying → learning → committing → complete. Verification failures loop back to executing. Paused/suspended states can resume to executing or abort to idle. Failed is terminal but can reset to idle. The executing state invokes a child phase actor with states: idle, wave_executing, wave_evaluating, phase_verifying, phase_fixing, phase_done, phase_blocked.

assertions.name: valid_json
assertions.description: Output file parses as valid JSON

assertions.name: valid_excalidraw_structure
assertions.description: Has type='excalidraw', version=2, and elements array

assertions.name: bidirectional_bindings
assertions.description: Every arrow binding has a matching boundElements entry on the target shape, and vice versa

assertions.name: all_parent_states_present
assertions.description: Text elements mention all 13 parent states: idle, preflight, routing, discussing, planning, executing, verifying, learning, committing, complete, paused, suspended, failed

assertions.name: child_phase_actor_states
assertions.description: Text elements mention child phase actor states: wave_executing, wave_evaluating, phase_verifying, phase_fixing, phase_done, phase_blocked

assertions.name: child_actor_grouped
assertions.description: Child phase actor states are visually grouped — either via a frame element or shared groupIds

assertions.name: has_arrows
assertions.description: Contains arrow elements connecting the states with transitions

assertions.name: sufficient_element_count
assertions.description: Has at least 40 total elements (20 states × 2 for shape+text, plus arrows)
